identity_match.note: The gazetted name is kept exactly as printed (OTTA HELENE MAREE). The link to Helen Zille rests on party + DA PR rank 1 + council, plus the given names Otta Helene (Britannica). Whether 'Maree' forms part of her full name is Unknown: no allowed source confirms it, and it is not recorded as a fact. No family details are recorded. Adverse court item: the SCA judgment ([2022] ZASCA 16) is a primary court record naming the Premier of the Western Cape (Helen Zille) as appellant, but its link to the gazetted OTTA HELENE MAREE rests on these Reported identity details, so the identity link for that item is Reported and the item is labelled Reported (no Confirmed claim that the gazette person is the court party).

court_matters.value: The Public Protector found that tweets on colonialism made by Zille on 15 March 2017, while she was Western Cape premier, breached the Executive Ethics Code and the Constitution, and recommended remedial action (Report No. 5 of 2018/19). Zille's review application was dismissed by the Gauteng Division of the High Court, Pretoria, and she appealed.
court_matters.label: Reported
court_matters.outcome: The SCA upheld the appeal and reviewed and set aside the Public Protector's findings and remedial action (Report No. 5 of 2018/19), 7 Feb 2022 (Premier of the Western Cape Province v The Public Protector & Another (771/2020) [2022] ZASCA 16).
